messages.subject: Energy & Country Leadership Executive | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Barbachano International / BIP Search Team,

Your executive-search work across energy and cross-border leadership aligns closely with my background in mining, government relations, ESG and corporate affairs. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities spanning regulatory and government engagement, ESG and social performance, external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where operational growth requires institutional trust, responsible development and disciplined execution. I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
